items.title: Kroger (KR) Report Says Its Baby Food Exceeded FDA Lead Guidance
items.summary: Kroger (NYSE:KR) faces scrutiny after CRFB reported elevated lead levels in Kroger-brand baby food sold at Harris Teeter stores. The investigation alleges lead concentrations exceeded FDA guidance despite Maryland and Virginia laws intended to reduce heavy metals in baby products. CRFB claims Kroger disclosures understated tested lead levels, and consumer advocates are urging stronger quality controls and clearer labeling.
